entities.name: Franciszka Urszula Wiśniowiecka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Franciszka Urszula Radziwiłł, was a Polish writer and playwright, the first female writer on the territory of modern Poland and Belarus. She was a Princess, the last female representative of the Wiśniowiecki noble house and a wife of Michał Kazimierz "Rybeńko" Radziwiłł.
